content.short: Licensed stablecoin infrastructure for banks and businesses in emerging markets, strongest in Africa.
content.description: Yellow Card lets banks, financial institutions and companies hold, send and settle stablecoins and pay out in more than 50 local currencies across 60+ countries. Businesses can open USD and EUR accounts, launch local stablecoins, earn yield and issue cards, with sanctions screening, AML monitoring and travel-rule compliance built in. It has processed more than $10 billion with over 100 tier-one banking and liquidity partners.
content.meta: Yellow Card gives banks and businesses licensed stablecoin rails and payouts in 50+ currencies across 60+ countries.
